task.title: Relics: renumber part positions when a gap runs out
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M68). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

Moving three parts back and forth is refused from move 608 of 10,000, because the position between two parts reaches its 256-byte limit. Random moves and moves to the front never reach it. Nothing renumbers positions today.

## Wanted

Decide whether renumbering is wanted. If it is, add a change that renumbers a relic's parts and replays safely from two clones.

## Done when

- A decision is recorded.
- If built: the alternating-move test runs 10,000 moves with no refusal, and two clones that renumber at once still agree.
